arguments.sql: SELECT strftime('%Y-%m', date) AS month, COUNT(*) AS transaction_count FROM transactions WHERE date >= '2019-01-01' AND date < '2020-01-01' GROUP BY month ORDER BY month
arguments.explanation: Counts every transaction in each month of 2019, listed in month order.
assumptions: The data only covers 2019-01-01 to 2019-10-31, so November and December 2019 will not appear.
All transactions are counted, whether they have a fraud label or not, and including those with errors or negative amounts.
